text: [calm, natural narrator voice] When will this needle turn? For the Earth, no one can say. In a simple computer model, chaos makes the forecast fade before the average wait ends. But how often the field flips, counted as crossings of zero, can still be answered. The answer hides in a shoebox of snapshots, read with the equations. And a machine can learn to dream such snapshots, between the simulated settings.
